key_findings: Orai1 mediates SOCE downstream of P2Y6, P2Y12 and TLR4 in spinal microglia and drives proinflammatory cytokine (IL-6, TNFα, MCP1, PGE2) production.
Microglial Orai1 deletion or the Orai1 inhibitor CM4620 reduced SNI-induced allodynia, spinal TNFα/IL-6/IL1-β/BDNF and lamina II excitatory potentiation in male but not female mice.
